name: Macropod
oneLiner: AUDM is Macropod's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 by approved clients and backed by AUD cash held at Westpac and Banking Circle.
collateral: Australian dollar cash held in segregated AUDM Trust reserve accounts at regulated Australian ADIs, currently Westpac Banking Corporation and Australian Settlements Ltd trading as Banking Circle
pegMechanism: Approved Macropod clients deposit AUD into the reserve to mint AUDM and return AUDM to Macropod for 1:1 AUD redemption by bank transfer, subject to onboarding, KYC/AML, sanctions, and compliance checks

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: Westpac Banking Corporation AUD reserve account
Australian Settlements Ltd / Banking Circle AUD reserve account

mintAuthority.summary: AUDM is issued by Macropod (AFSL 566313, AUSTRAC DCE100887005-001); approved clients deposit AUD into the AUDM Trust reserve to mint and return AUDM for 1:1 redemption, all gated through the issuer's compliance/onboarding backend.

controls.label: Macropod issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Macropod mints AUDM against AUD deposited into the AUDM Trust reserve by KYC/AML-approved clients and redeems 1:1; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

review.evidence: Macropod docs describe a single regulated issuer minting AUDM against custodied AUD reserves at Westpac and Banking Circle, with client onboarding/KYC gating; mint/redeem is centralized.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer model established from project materials; on-chain token owner/minter admins on Ethereum, Solana, and Redbelly not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain token owner/minter admin on Ethereum (0x0815...cbdd), Solana, and Redbelly before raising confidence.
